title: Scan4D Focus Region JSON Schema
description: The box a focus scan captures (docs/design/capture-modes.md). Written beside each focus scan (focus_region.json, also at the root of its export zip), and the format a downstream processor (e.g. a VLM) hands the app to request a focus scan: by deep link scan4d://focus-region?data=<base64url of this JSON>, or as a file imported from a space's Rescan button. Gravity-aligned: the box turns about +Y only. Metres and radians.

version.description: Format version. Currently 1. Optional on import.

location_id.description: The space (ScanLocation id) the region belongs to. Required for a deep link (it picks the space to open); ignored for a file imported inside a space.

center_m.description: Box centre [x, y, z] in metres, in the frame named by frame_is_canonical / frame_scan_id. +Y is up (gravity).

yaw_rad.description: Turn of the box about +Y, radians (right-handed; 0 = box axes along the frame's axes). Default 0.

size_m.description: Full box size [width (local x), height (y), depth (local z)] in metres. Each side positive and at most 10 m (larger is a room scan's job).

label.description: Human label shown on the scan card, e.g. "work table". Optional.

source.description: How the region was made: drawn on the mesh, taken from a RoomPlan object, or handed to the app. Imports are recorded as "import" whatever they say.

detail_level.description: How much to capture: check (about 5 photos, finishes by itself), detail (about 30), splat (150 or more, for reconstruction). Default check.

frame_scan_id.description: The room scan whose mesh frame the box is in, when drawn in the app. Optional on import.

frame_is_canonical.description: True (default): the box is in the space's canonical frame, the original scan's frame, which every registered room scan's mesh.obj, roomplan.json and the exports' mesh share. False: in frame_scan_id's raw capture frame (an unregistered scan).

created_at_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds. Optional on import (set to the import time).
